_about: Brief 2-5 step 7 — high and critical advisories in production dependencies that are accepted, each with its reason and an expiry. scripts/dependency-scan.mjs fails CI on any high or critical advisory not listed here, and on any entry past its expiry. Remove an entry when its fix lands.

accepted.advisory: DeepmergeTS stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs (GHSA via npm advisory 1145093)
accepted.reason: Reached only by the Prisma CLI loading its own configuration at build and migrate time, from files in this repository; no request or user input reaches it. npm's only offered fix is a Prisma downgrade to 6.12.0.

accepted.advisory: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements (GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv)
accepted.reason: Reached only by lib/appleWallet.ts, which uses node-forge to SIGN Apple Wallet passes with the company's own certificate; the advisory is in signature VERIFICATION, which this code never performs on anything. No fixed release is published yet (npm offers none); revisit when 1.4.1+ lands.

accepted.advisory: Inherited libvips / libheif / librsvg vulnerabilities (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj, GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c, GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w)
accepted.reason: At run time sharp resizes only an associate's own stored profile photo (routes/nativeApp.ts, wallet passes), an image that was already accepted and stored by the photo upload with its type and size checks; the web app uses it only at build time on the repository's own icon. No fixed release is published yet (npm offers none); upgrade when one lands.
